questions.question: In Home Alone, what is the family’s last name?
questions.note: Kevin McCallister, played by Macaulay Culkin.

questions.question: In The Silence of the Lambs, what name does the FBI give the serial killer Clarice is hunting?
questions.note: Ted Levine’s Jame Gumb; Hannibal Lecter is already behind bars.

questions.question: Who plays chaos-theory mathematician Ian Malcolm in Jurassic Park?
questions.note: Neill is Dr. Grant; Attenborough is John Hammond; Knight is Newman-ish Nedry.

questions.question: Which 1994 prison drama, based on a Stephen King novella, follows banker Andy Dufresne?
questions.note: A slow starter in theaters; now a fixture of “best film ever” polls.

questions.question: Which 1994 film features a twist contest at a diner called Jack Rabbit Slim’s?
questions.note: Uma Thurman and John Travolta; the trophy is a modest little statuette.

questions.question: In Forrest Gump, what does Forrest name his shrimp boat?
questions.note: After Jenny Curran; the company is Bubba Gump Shrimp.

questions.question: In Titanic, what is the name of the blue diamond necklace?
questions.note: Cal’s gift to Rose; it ends up on the ocean floor.

questions.question: In The Matrix, what is Neo’s name inside the simulation?
What is the name of Russell Crowe’s character in Gladiator?
questions.note: Maximus Decimus Meridius, commander of the Armies of the North.

questions.question: In The Lord of the Rings, what was Gollum’s name before the Ring corrupted him?
questions.note: Déagol is the cousin who first finds the Ring in the river.
